title: Spicy Thai Chicken Noodles
description: A Chinese-inspired dish made with spicy Thai flavors, featuring chicken and noodles as the main ingredients.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the wok and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the wok and set aside.
Add the Thai red curry paste to the wok and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the noodles to the wok and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until they are well coated with the curry paste.
Return the chicken to the wok and stir-fry everything together for 1 minute.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the noodles and chicken to a serving platter and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Serve with lime wedges on the side.
Enjoy your spicy Thai chicken noodles!
